technical.name: Terminal Minimal
technical.description: Dark background, monospace type throughout, no ornament. Functional and uncompromising. Every element earns its place.
technical.palette: Near-black ground (#0d0d0d), off-white text (#e0e0e0), single muted accent (amber or green).
technical.typography: Monospace primary — JetBrains Mono or Iosevka. Consistent weight. No italic.
technical.references: htop, k9s, the Stripe CLI, Linear issue view.

technical.name: Technical Document
technical.description: Off-white ground, dense information layout, RFC/spec aesthetic. Designed for reading, not scanning. Typography does all the work.
technical.palette: Warm white (#f5f3ef), dark text (#1a1a1a), minimal color — one functional accent only.
technical.typography: Sans-serif (Inter or similar) for body, mono for code. Tight line height. Strong hierarchy through size and weight alone.
technical.references: Stripe docs, Oxide Computer RFCs, GNU manpages reformatted.

technical.name: Precision Interface
technical.description: Neutral mid-range palette, strong grid, engineering-tool aesthetic. Balanced between document and application. Calm but capable.
technical.palette: Mid-grey ground (#f0f0f0 or #1c1c1c), charcoal type, restrained use of blue or slate as action color.
technical.typography: Sans-serif for UI, mono for data. Clear size differentiation. No decorative weight use.
technical.references: Figma sidebar, Retool, Zed editor, TablePlus.

creative.name: Editorial
creative.description: Strong typographic hierarchy, restrained palette, print-design influences. Work foreground, everything else background.
creative.palette: Off-white or cream (#f7f4ef), near-black type, accent used once — a single warm or cool tone.
creative.typography: A good serif for display, neutral sans for body. Generous leading. No decorative fonts.
creative.references: Are.na, Typewolf, Emigre back catalog, Letterform Archive.

creative.name: Quiet Studio
creative.description: Neutral and considered. Nothing decorative. Space used to direct attention, not fill it.
creative.palette: Warm white (#fafaf8) or deep neutral (#141414), type-only color use. No gradients.
creative.typography: One typeface family, two weights. Let leading and spacing create rhythm.
creative.references: Pentagram case studies, Swiss International Style, Muji product design.

creative.name: Contemporary Craft
creative.description: Tactile references — paper, grain, texture — applied with restraint. Warmth without nostalgia.
creative.palette: Off-white base with a warm paper tone, subtle texture overlays, earthy accent.
creative.typography: Mix: display serif + utility sans. Comfortable reading size. Generous margins.
creative.references: Oak Studio, Analog, Offscreen Magazine, Present & Correct.

product.name: Focused Product
product.description: Clean, professional, information-forward. Looks like it was built to be used, not to be admired. Trust through clarity.
product.palette: White or light grey ground, dark neutral type, one brand color used only for primary actions.
product.typography: Neutral sans-serif, systematic sizing, no personality — the product is the personality.

product.name: Minimal Commerce
product.description: Premium restraint. No decorative elements. White space signals quality. Type-driven.
product.palette: White ground, black type, one warm accent for selective emphasis.
product.typography: A refined sans-serif. Large display size for key claims. Small, tracked caps for labels.
product.references: Stripe marketing, Basecamp, Arc browser landing page.

product.name: Structured Trust
product.description: Grid-heavy, methodical, legible. Communicates that things are in order. More function, less flourish.
product.palette: Light neutral ground, two text weights (body + emphasis), a contained accent color.
product.typography: Professional sans-serif — GT Walsheim or Plus Jakarta or similar. Tight tracking for headings.
product.references: Harvest app, FreshBooks, Notion, Loom landing page.

fallback.name: Type Forward
fallback.description: Typography as the only design element. No illustration, no photography, no pattern. Words do everything.
fallback.palette: Black and white, one optional accent. No gradients.
fallback.typography: One great typeface. Multiple weights. Extreme size contrast. Nothing else needed.
fallback.references: Early Bloomberg Businessweek covers, Helvetica film poster, The Economist.

fallback.name: System Neutral
fallback.description: Invisible design — system fonts, default spacing, no signature. The brand is in the content, not the container.
fallback.palette: System defaults. One custom color — the brand color. Everything else inherited.
fallback.typography: System UI stack. Optimized for the OS it runs on.
fallback.references: HN, iA Writer, Pinboard, older Stripe.
